en: Fixed effort being turned off for a subagent's model for the session if Bedrock, Google Cloud's Agent Platform or Foundry refused its progress summary's effort setting (regression in 2.1.327)
zh: 修复了 Bedrock、Google Cloud 的 Agent Platform 或 Foundry 拒绝 subagent 模型的进度摘要 effort 设置时，该模型在整个 session 中 effort 被关闭的问题（2.1.327 引入的回归）
